description: This file defines the UploadStream class, which implements a custom PHP stream wrapper for handling file uploads within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for stream registration, file and directory management, and security checks related to the Suhosin PHP extension.

classes.name: UploadStream
classes.description: A PHP stream wrapper class for handling upload streams, including security checks, directory management, and stream operations.

methods.name: getSuhosinStatus
methods.description: Checks if the Suhosin PHP extension allows the upload stream protocol based on configuration.

methods.name: getDir
methods.description: Returns the upload directory path, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: writable
methods.description: Checks if the upload directory is writable.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the custom upload stream wrapper.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Converts a stream URL to a filesystem path, validating it.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures that the directory for a given path exists, creating it if needed.

methods.name: dir_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory handle for reading.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Casts the stream to a specific type (not implemented).

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream for reading or writing.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: move_uploaded_file
methods.description: Moves an uploaded file to a new location.
